summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/measure-sheet-data 2.6.3 declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes the bundled sibling file math_init.js under that freshly downloaded Bun binary via execFileSync. math_init.js is 727KB of single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (function WV8StW pushing/shifting a ~500-entry hex/fragment table) with hex-mangled identifiers, no human-readable strings, and no import path from the declared library entry (dist/index.js). The package advertises itself as 'Measurement data for glass for ServiceTitan', a data/UI library with no purpose-aligned reason to fetch a second language runtime or execute an opaque blob at install. The combination — install-time fetch of an alternate runtime plus execution of an obfuscated bundled payload disconnected from the library's stated purpose — is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern. The true behavior of math_init.js is not recoverable without running it under Bun on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
